in_marathi.name: Sharunikaal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity and Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharunikaal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharunikaal is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Sharu' which means 'Prosperity' and 'Nikaal' which means 'Victory'. This name signifies the Goddess of Prosperity and Victory. It is believed that this name bestows upon the bearer immense strength, beauty, and protection.
